dct_description_sm: Small mammals and hares play a keystone role in both Arctic and boreal ecosystems. They are a major prey species for many northern carnivores. The cyclic fluctuations in the abundance of small mammals and hares are often repeated in the fluctuations seen in the abundance of their predators. To inform programs, policies and environmental management; small mammals are monitored in the Northwest Territories.
dct_title_s: Small Mammal and Hare Survey, Government of the Northwest Territories
